_comment: The `refill` section of the configuration file. Amounts are decimal strings in whole units (ETH, USDC). Without `referenceCaseCostEth` a pair's loop only records observations and never refills (launch gate). Keys starting with `_` are ignored.
_referenceCaseCostEth: ETH cost of one reference case (three jurors). The trigger is available native ETH strictly below lowWaterCases x this.
_targetCases: Nominal capacity. A sweep that cannot reach it is a partial refill: it proceeds and notifies (warning).
_economicMinimums: Per collected-asset symbol: a withdrawable arbitration balance under this is deferred (not withdrawn, not bridged).
_depositMethod: `function`: the HomeGateway's payable deposit from src/gateway/abi/homeGateway.ts (pending signature). `nativeTransfer`: value with empty calldata, only for a gateway whose receive() is verified.
_maxAmbiguousDeferrals: An ambiguous transfer deferral (insufficient-holding, or a reason the loop does not recognise) is retried at most this many consecutive times or this many seconds, then the operation is attention. price-unavailable and no-route deferrals are retried without a bound.
